parts.name: Blade Handle Set
parts.Basic_description: This part is one half of the scissors, consisting of a metal blade and a plastic handle loop.
parts.Functional_description: It provides one cutting edge and one handle for gripping and applying force during cutting.
parts.Movement_description: It rotates around the screw pivot to open and close against the other blade handle set.

parts.name: Blade Handle Set
parts.Basic_description: This is the second half of the scissors, also composed of a metal blade and a plastic handle loop.
parts.Functional_description: It provides the opposing cutting edge and handle, working together with the first blade handle set to perform cutting.
parts.Movement_description: It pivots around the screw to move in a scissoring motion relative to the other blade handle set.

parts.name: Screw
parts.Basic_description: This is the central screw that connects the two blade handle sets together.
parts.Functional_description: It acts as the pivot point, allowing the two blades to rotate smoothly while maintaining alignment.
parts.Movement_description: It remains fixed in place, enabling rotational movement of the two blade handle sets around it.
